notice: Python and libraries on this page: the page's own programs (the playground) run in your browser, in Python 3.13.2, while the chapter's examples ran under Python 3.14.6 on Linux with pyttsx3 2.99, openai-whisper 20250625, yt-dlp 2026.11.23, torch 2.15.0 (CPU), NumPy 2.5.4, eSpeak NG 1.51 and ffmpeg 6.1.1. Some recorded examples also ran under Python 3.12.3 with pyttsx3 2.98 (the pinned release of the book) and under a Python 3.14.6 with no packages. A browser has no eSpeak NG or ffmpeg, cannot start programs and does not have pyttsx3, Whisper or yt-dlp, so none of the 74 examples of the chapter runs here: every one is shown as recorded under Python 3.14.6, not run, each with its reason. Stand-ins: there is no sound card, so nothing was heard and the speech went to WAV files, a local stand-in for a loudspeaker; a public-domain reading of the Gettysburg Address from the Internet Archive stands in for YouTube, from which nothing was downloaded. The five pictures under five concepts were drawn by programs of the first deck from audio that eSpeak NG spoke; they were not made on this page. The deck, whose text is the Lecture tab, is the deck 4.0.0 (42 slides). Its 16 examples are those of the Chapter code tab; they ran for the deck under Python 3.14.6 on this machine, and none of them runs in a browser, so all 16 are shown as recorded, each with its reason. Windows, macOS, a sound card, a microphone and a graphics card were never used.

example_notes.The packages and the tools: Python 3.14.6; three packages; ffmpeg and eSpeak found; no sound card. Recorded under Python 3.14.6 with pyttsx3 2.99, openai-whisper 20250625 and yt-dlp 2026.11.23; it does not run on this page.
example_notes.Saying a sentence: say() returned None; runAndWait() ran the events; the second call did not return. Recorded under Python 3.14.6 with pyttsx3 2.99, openai-whisper 20250625 and yt-dlp 2026.11.23; it does not run on this page.
example_notes.The voices of the engine: 131 voices; the first is Afrikaans; the saved sentence lasts 1.48 seconds. Recorded under Python 3.14.6 with pyttsx3 2.99, openai-whisper 20250625 and yt-dlp 2026.11.23; it does not run on this page.
